improvements.title: Modern video style
improvements.detail: Bold pop-in captions, red numbers, crisp colour, progress bar, spoken like/share/subscribe ending.

improvements.title: Natural endings + deeper research
improvements.detail: No template endings; topics must pass 4 viral tests: famous, shocking, high stakes, about YOU.

improvements.title: Mixkit footage + music, no repeats
improvements.detail: Free-licence Mixkit clips mixed in, 15 hand-picked dark tracks, a clip is never used twice.

improvements.title: Only fitting archive films
improvements.detail: Old films must match the script's words, or they are skipped.

improvements.title: Titles, thumbnails, card styles
